defect_summary: Producer session ran gh workflow run start-release, got HTTP 403, then instructed an Actions click. Origin release/v* creation is not a ./release planner action.
unsuitable_process: CREATE_RELEASE_LINE only creates a local git branch. Origin release/v* is required by the start-release workflow and GitHub ruleset 25824126, but that creation is not a planner REPAIR or HUMAN_DECISION, so a producer session fills the gap with a side-channel dispatch and a chat checklist.
climb_steps: Chat instructed an Actions click after HTTP 403.
gh workflow run start-release is not an executor action and fails with 403 on an integration token.
CREATE_RELEASE_LINE in goals/hub_release/execute.sh only git checkout -b.
docs/adoption/RELEASE.md names the Actions tab but that sentence is not a planner stop.
ADR 0049 requires every intentional release stop to be a planner action.

repo_touch.belief: ADR 0025 — defects name unsuitable process, not agents
